title: ChatInboxConversationsResult
description: chat.inbox-conversations-result@1: an inbox's conversations ({ conversations }: waiting first, each with status, who has it, the visitor's name and whether their site verified them, a preview and unread count), one conversation's messages ({ conversation, messages }, ?after= a message id), a reply ({ message }), its saved replies ({ replies }), or the owner's export (?format=json: { inbox, exported_at, conversations: [{ …, messages }] }; ?format=csv is text/csv, one row per message). A message is { id, author: visitor | agent | ai | system, author_name, body, created_at, account? }.
